name: Plus Alpha Consulting Co.,Ltd.
summary: Plus Alpha Consulting Co.,Ltd. provides marketing and HR solutions in japan. The company develops and operates Visualization Engine, a customer experience feedback system; ALPHA SCOPE, a FAQ solution; CustomerRings, a customer relationship management/MA system; Talent Palette, a talent management system; Kimisuka, a new graduate direct recruiting service platform. It also engages in recruitment consulting and consulting business; and provision of work shift creation and management system for the retail and service industry.
